description: This file implements automatic differentiation (autodiff) runtime functions for PyTorch's JIT compiler, including gradient graph construction, reverse-mode differentiation, and related utilities.

classes.name: GradientHelper
classes.description: Helper class for constructing gradients during autodiff.

classes.name: ReverseDetails
classes.description: Holds information about the reverse graph and gradient mapping during backpropagation.

methods.name: needTrimGrad
methods.description: Determines if a node's outputs need gradient trimming due to multiple outputs where only the first requires grad.

methods.name: isDifferentiable
methods.description: Checks if a node or graph is differentiable based on its kind and attributes.

methods.name: build_script_grad
methods.description: Constructs gradient graphs from scripted forward and backward graphs for a node.

methods.name: addReverseInline
methods.description: Adds a reverse node to a graph for backpropagation, setting up gradient accumulation.

methods.name: getReverseCaptures
methods.description: Collects values used in the reverse graph that need to be captured for backpropagation.

methods.name: liftConstants
methods.description: Moves constant nodes into a specified block to avoid recomputation.

methods.name: foldSizeIfNotEqual
methods.description: Folds aten::_size_if_not_equal nodes when shape information is available.

methods.name: deduplicateSizeCaptures
methods.description: Replaces duplicate size captures with a single shared node to optimize graph.

methods.name: eliminateDeadCode
methods.description: Removes unused nodes from the reverse graph after backpropagation setup.

methods.name: Optimize
methods.description: Performs various graph optimizations during autodiff, including constant lifting and size folding.

methods.name: lambdaLiftReverse
methods.description: Splits the reverse graph into its own graph, capturing necessary intermediates.

methods.name: packReturnValuesIntoTuple
methods.description: Wraps the return values of a graph into a tuple for consistent output.

methods.name: differentiate
methods.description: Main entry point for computing the gradient graph of a given computation graph.
